title: 玩家操作不影响游戏进程与结局
description: 玩家的按键、选择或互动对剧情、独白、结局或游戏状态没有实际影响，操作仅能改变视角或手部动作，无法推进或改变游戏，导致游戏缺乏互动性和参与感。
evidence: Give little control over Luxemburg, you simpl use the keyboard to decide in which subconscious tick he will partake.
almost nothing you're able to do in the game matters

evidence_items.quote: none of these progress the gameplay in any way
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作不影响游戏进程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些都不会以任何方式推进游戏进程

evidence_items.quote: you don't actually need to press any buttons you just sit back and watch the disappointment unfold, it really plays itself just like life does
evidence_items.description: 玩家无需按键，游戏自行播放，缺乏互动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你其实根本不需要按任何按钮，你只要往后一坐，看着失望一点点展开，它真的会自己玩自己，就像生活一样

evidence_items.quote: a unica interação sua com o jogo é olhar pros lados apertando algumas teclas, comendo pão/sopa e bebendo vinho
evidence_items.description: 玩家唯一互动只是按键环顾四周、吃面包喝汤，对剧情没有影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你与这款游戏的唯一互动就是按几个键往两边看，吃面包/喝汤，还有喝葡萄酒

evidence_items.quote: Nothing you do matters
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作对故事没有影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你做什么都无关紧要

evidence_items.quote: Scheinbar macht es überhaupt keinen Unterschied, auf welche Tasten-Shortcuts ihr klickt oder wie ihr ihn sich verhalten lasst.

evidence_items.quote_zh: 显然，你点击哪些按键快捷键，或者你让他如何表现，似乎完全没有任何区别。

evidence_items.quote: You don't do anything except listen to the protagonist's inner monologue, and tap keys to make him touch his face, swish his wine, etc.
evidence_items.description: 按键操作只触发触摸脸部、晃酒等动作，对游戏进程没有实际影响

evidence_items.quote: Las acciones no van más lejos de mirar el reloj, mover la mano, beber vino, cosa que no altera el juego para nada, la historia es siempre la misma hagas lo que hagas.
evidence_items.description: 玩家的操作不会改变游戏进程，故事始终相同
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些动作不外乎看看表、动动手、喝喝酒，这些对游戏毫无改变，无论你做什么，故事始终如一。

evidence_items.quote: Никак не влияет на сюжет
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作对剧情没有影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对剧情毫无影响

evidence_items.quote: almost nothing you're able to do in the game matters
evidence_items.description: 游戏中几乎所有能做的事都不影响结果

evidence_items.quote: This is not a game its an animation with limited control.
evidence_items.description: 游戏控制非常有限，更像动画
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这不是游戏，而是一部控制有限的动画。

evidence_items.quote: you can choose what meaningless task you want the character to perform which has no actual input on anything whatsoever.

evidence_items.quote_zh: 它只是随机的动作和一个自言自语的男人

evidence_items.quote: you don't actually need to press any buttons for most of it to continue the dialogue
evidence_items.description: 大部分对话无需按键即可继续

evidence_items.quote: The decisions you do make, won't have any effect on the game.
evidence_items.description: 玩家的选择对游戏没有任何影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你所做的那些决定，不会对游戏产生任何影响。

evidence_items.quote: What you do has no real impact
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作对游戏没有实际影响

evidence_items.description: 玩家操作无法改变游戏结局
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你所做的任何事都无法改变游戏的结局

evidence_items.quote: Nothing happens and you can't actually do anything.
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作没有任何效果，无法做任何事

evidence_items.quote: you can tap the desk to try and get some kind of stimuli
evidence_items.description: 点击桌子等操作没有实际效果

evidence_items.quote: the lack of interactivity
evidence_items.description: 缺乏互动性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏互动性

evidence_items.quote: The "game aspect" is just clicking to do random things while sitting down while not really advancing the game as it's all just linear.
evidence_items.description: 点击只是做随机的事，不能推进游戏，全是线性的

evidence_items.quote: He responded to this apparent criticism by removing that requirement altogether, making the experience an automatic self-completion, regardless of actions taken by the player.
evidence_items.description: 更新后玩家操作不再影响游戏进程，体验自动完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他回应这一明显的批评的方式是完全取消了那个要求，使这段体验变成自动自我完成，无论玩家采取什么行动。

evidence_items.quote: you press keyboard buttons to do pointless actions
evidence_items.description: 按键执行无意义的动作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你按键盘按钮来做毫无意义的事情

evidence_items.quote: Choices are irrelevant, having no effect on the ending or even, seemingly, the journey to get there
evidence_items.description: 选择无关紧要，对结局和过程没有影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 选择无关紧要，对结局甚至似乎对到达结局的过程都没有任何影响

evidence_items.quote: monologue where you press random buttons

evidence_items.quote: We have no agency in the game or story
evidence_items.description: 玩家对游戏和故事没有自主权
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我们在游戏或故事中没有任何自主权

evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果我们的行为对故事有意义，而不是选择先吃什么，或者我们的角色看向哪一边等等，那会有趣得多。

evidence_items.quote_zh: 这部短篇叙事作品无论有没有玩家互动都会讲述它的故事。

evidence_items.description: 玩家无法影响游戏进程或结局
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你按下开始，你可以等大约25分钟，什么都不做，然后就赢了。

evidence_items.quote: you don't play it, it's a monologue from some sad dude

evidence_items.quote: I would have no influence over the game whatsoever, unable to even trigger events
evidence_items.description: 玩家对游戏没有任何影响，甚至无法触发事件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我对游戏完全没有任何影响力，甚至连触发事件都做不到

evidence_items.quote: Nothing you do has any impact on anything. Any button press you make simply occupies the visual space
evidence_items.description: 玩家按键对剧情和结果没有任何影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你做的任何事都不会对任何事物产生任何影响。你按下的任何按钮只是占据了视觉空间

evidence_items.quote: No apparent control over the game
evidence_items.description: 玩家对游戏没有明显控制权
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对游戏没有明显的控制权

evidence_items.quote: the added ability of being able to change the camera angle and get the main (and only) character to perform very limited subconscious actions, that have no apparent affect on the movie
evidence_items.description: 玩家只能让角色做有限的潜意识动作，对剧情没有明显影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 额外增加的能力，让你能够改变镜头角度，并让主角（也是唯一角色）做出非常有限的潜意识动作，而这些动作对这部影片没有明显影响

evidence_items.quote:
I thought I'm doing a significant things with pressing this and that button.
But turn out it's just a pointless game.
evidence_items.description: 按键操作没有产生有意义的效果

我以为按这个那个按钮是在做什么重要的事。
但结果这只是一个毫无意义的游戏。

evidence_items.quote: The player has no control over the narrative; there are some controls you can use to look around, idly fiddle with stuff and such, but the narrative will soldier on whatever you do, or indeed, even if you do nothing.

evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家对叙事没有任何控制权；你可以使用一些操作来环顾四周、无所事事地摆弄东西之类的，但无论你做什么，甚至你什么都不做，叙事都会照常推进。

evidence_items.quote: ONE or TWO choices in the game that would actually make a difference

毫无意义！
(((((人们能买到的最没价值的……艺术品。)))))
如果游戏里有一两个真正能带来改变的选择，我本会喜欢，甚至几乎会推荐它。嗯，我要不要拿一片吐司？如果拿，我该配点东西吃还是干吃？我是摆弄左手还是右手？为什么不两只手一起？也许我被放鸽子的时候还想多任务并行呢？无论创作者想在这个故事里传达什么，都被他们那种毫无意义又平淡乏味的讲述方式给弄丢了。这是一次我希望自己当初就放鸽子的购买，能省几分钱就省几分钱吧，别买这个游戏。
